name: wpmake/post-purchase-hub
description: Post-Purchase Hub for WooCommerce — order timeline, self-service actions and a merchant request queue.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run PHP_CodeSniffer against the WordPress-Extra, WordPress-Docs and WooCommerce-Core rulesets.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix the PHPCS violations that are safely fixable.
scripts-descriptions.security:gates: Run the six security grep gates CI enforces (docs/SECURITY-AUDIT.md).
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan level 7 over src/ with WordPress and WooCommerce stubs.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the unit suite (no WordPress bootstrap).
scripts-descriptions.test:int: Run the integration suite (requires wp-env; run once with HPOS on and once off).
scripts-descriptions.build: Build both distribution zips into dist/.
scripts-descriptions.verify: Inspect the built zips for edition leakage and packaging faults.
scripts-descriptions.release: Build both zips and verify them.
